# prime-metergroup

prime-rs: MeterGroup component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/metergroup) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-metergroup)

MeterGroup: a port of `p-metergroup` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Root `div.p-metergroup[role=meter]` (instead of the host `<p-metergroup>`), segments in `div.p-metergroup-meters` and a list
of labels before or after them. The `label`, `start`, `end`, `meter`, `icon` templates are callbacks. An item icon is a `ViewFn`
(for example, an icon from `prime-icons`), not a font class name.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_metergroup::{MeterGroup, MeterItem};

let items = vec![MeterItem::new("Apps", "#34d399", 16.0)];
let html = view! { <MeterGroup value=items /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("width: 16%") && html.contains("Apps"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-metergroup = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["metergroup"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
